analyst_view.overall: Early view: Andoni Iraola's Liverpool have been patchy, losing 1-0 at home to Arsenal after struggling to build play, with Hugo Ekitike, Jeremie Frimpong and Conor Bradley out and Ryan Gravenberch a doubt. Leeds under Daniel Farke beat Tottenham 1-0 last time out after a 4-1 win over Newcastle earlier in the season, but have doubts over Dominic Calvert-Lewin, Anton Stach and Noah Okafor.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. Liverpool have had several low-scoring home games this season, including 0-0 with Fulham and 0-1 with Arsenal, and Leeds kept a clean sheet against Spurs. I lean a little lower.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.9 corners. Liverpool should have most of the ball against a Leeds side that has been happy to defend and break, and sustained pressure tends to produce corners. I lean slightly higher.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards, mostly to Leeds. Nothing in the news points to a heated game, so I stay with the number until the referee is named.

shots.text: The numbers say 29 shots. Liverpool will dominate territory, but their build-up has been slow, with full-backs offering little going forward against Arsenal. That evens out, so I stay with the number.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.7 shots on target. With Ekitike out and Liverpool struggling to create clear chances lately, I lean a touch lower.
